subject: An initial simple unit test framework (#344)
reason: The change only adds a standalone unit test framework: a new src/unit/ directory, a valkey-unit-tests binary and Makefile/CI wiring, and it moves the existing #ifdef SERVER_TEST test code for crc64 and intset out of the production files into that framework. The production implementations of crc64 and intset are unchanged; the sole server.c edit removes two entries from the SERVER_TEST-only serverTests[] table, a developer test mode not compiled into release builds and never exercised by a running server. No command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster behaviour changes, so no fuzzer sce
